title: Cute Infant Sitting on Blanket, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-20th century studio or home portrait of a wide-eyed baby sitting propped up against a plush armchair draped in a white knitted blanket. The infant is wearing a classic knit romper and small white booties. The print features decorative scalloped/deckle edges typical of 1950s photo developing.
